name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1480: Fourth instance of one bug (REG-044, REG-054, REG-077): a tool that prints a check mark on a Hebrew cp1255 console dies REPORTING, so a correct tree exits non-zero. tv/console_safe.py is now the single place that fixes it, wired into replay, robot_smoke, prove_real_intake, test_button_matrix and test_roundtrip_sim; TestToolsCanReportTheirVerdict fails any CLI that prints non-ASCII without it. Fixing the encoding immediately exposed what it had been hiding: test_button_matrix asserted the version stamp matched ^v8-digit-digit, written at v849 and wrong since v900 - roughly 600 versions of reporting FAILED on every correct build. It now compares the live app against tv/WINDOWS_SHIP.json, which stays true at any version and catches the thing worth catching: a running app older than the tree under test.
